description.p: Envelope is a mail and calendar app for Linux that feels instant. Everything is stored locally, so opening, searching and organizing mail never waits for the network.

ul.li: Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, Exchange, iCloud, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP server
Unified inbox, conversations, split inbox and lightning-fast full-text search
Calendar with CalDAV, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and Exchange, including invitations
Contacts synced with CardDAV, Google and Microsoft 365
Keyboard shortcuts for everything, command palette, undo send, snooze and send later
Rules, templates and reminders when nobody replies
Privacy first: remote images and trackers blocked by default
Optional AI assistance with your own provider (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama and more)

screenshot.caption: Unified inbox with a conversation open
Dark mode and the month view
Optional AI summaries and suggested replies
Answering an invitation, with conflicts shown

description.p: Finding, sorting and trusting your mail: search that writes its own queries, the people and lists that matter one click away, S/MIME, and the layout you like in as many windows as you like.

ul.li: Search options that write the query, saved and recent searches, and people suggested as you type
VIPs with a mailbox of their own, and notifications for their mail only
Subscriptions: every newsletter and mailing list in one place, to unsubscribe from or clear out
Mail marked important shows a red mark, and the composer marks yours
S/MIME signed and encrypted mail is read, checked and sent, with certificates in Settings
Contact groups in Contacts and in the To and Cc fields
The reading pane on the right, below or off; single messages instead of conversations; other sort orders
Conversations and messages being written in windows of their own
Propose a new time for a meeting, and answer proposals
Birthdays and week numbers in the calendar, notification sounds, and a notice when a new version is out

description.p: Switching from other mail apps, staying organized, a calendar that repeats and travels, and an app that works from the keyboard and in half a screen.

ul.li: Accounts set up in Thunderbird, Evolution, Geary or GNOME Online Accounts are offered when adding an account
Mail from mbox files and saved messages can be imported into any folder
Contacts can be imported from vCard and from Gmail, Outlook and Thunderbird CSV exports, exported as vCards, and merged when they are in an address book twice
Folders and labels can be created, renamed, nested, recolored and deleted, and Trash and Spam emptied
Not spam, block sender, rules on existing mail, and follow-up reminders that can be marked done
Drafts open for editing from anywhere, with more formatting, forwarding as an attachment and saving all attachments
Custom repeating events, event time zones, a second time zone and a work week view
Account settings after setup, with a connection test, and notifications per account
Narrow windows, keyboard menus and dialogs, screen reader names and higher contrast

description.p: Tasks, next to your mail and in your calendar.

ul.li: A Tasks view with Today, Upcoming, Important and each account's lists, with due dates and times, notes, subtasks and importance
Quick add that understands dates and times in the interface language
Turn a conversation into a task that links back to it
Tasks with a due date in the calendar, and notifications when they are due
Two-way sync with Google Tasks, Microsoft To Do, Exchange and CalDAV servers, plus a list on this computer
Questions such as confirming a deletion are asked in the app's own dialogs

description.p: End-to-end encryption, the interface in ten languages, and a scheduling assistant for meetings.

ul.li: Encrypt and sign mail with OpenPGP; keys are created for you and exchanged with Autocrypt
The interface in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese
See when guests are busy and move a meeting to the next time everyone is free
Subscribe to calendars by URL
Automatic replies for Microsoft 365, Exchange, Gmail and servers with ManageSieve
Mute conversations
Open saved messages, calendar files and contact cards from the file manager
Add, change and delete Exchange contacts

description.p: New-mail notifications get Archive and Mark as Read buttons, and Gmail send-as addresses become identities with their signatures.

ul.li: The window no longer stays hidden at startup on some systems
Starting at login keeps Envelope in the tray
Notifications name the sender for every kind of account
